copy_audit.meaning: No intermediate edit trace exists. Final equality is observable, hidden copying/anchoring/reversion is not identified. This is v11 (seventeenth academic update), not an experiment named v17.

dispatch_clarifications.fairness: Full shared instruction from base protocol verbatim, same system and input table; only schema/output representation differs.
dispatch_clarifications.no_hidden_category: Never use understood-but-formatting-error as a truth label.
dispatch_clarifications.no_protocol_edits: Base v12 file remains unchanged; this prospective addendum clarifies counting and model re-entry only.
dispatch_clarifications.runtime_dependency_lock: Record exact Python version, installed distribution versions and SHA256 of Python-source/metadata files for openai and recursive installed dependencies, excluding caches. Require exact match before dispatch. No new package added.
dispatch_clarifications.score: Validate patch/rewrite envelope and strict JSON without repair. Expand valid patch into existing C envelope; model proposal unmodified. Independent proposal-only score reported even when patch invalid, never grants joint/table credit.
dispatch_clarifications.stopped_run: Retain all 72 assigned denominators and one attempted-call journal; no automatic resume/retry/replacement. Report reservations separately from known cost for failed/unknown-usage attempts.
dispatch_clarifications.unchanged_input: For patches empty edits imply unchanged table; valid empty edits still fail semantic table repair on wrong inputs.

sol_reentry.action_when_not_triggered: No automatic Sol top-up. Report trigger numerator/denominator and all residual failure types. A later changed-scale/key confirmation requires a separate preregistration including Sol regardless of this trigger.
sol_reentry.action_when_triggered: Queue a separate prospective Sol confirmation of the same 72-assignment schedule, same rules/feedback/schema/budget, changing only to frozen Sol model effort=low, omitting temperature. Commit exact Sol requests and a separate lock before dispatch; never pool models. No Sol calls in the current 72-call run.
sol_reentry.evaluation_timing: After all 72 Luna calls, frozen offline replay and all scoring agreement; no sequential peeking/early Sol dispatch.
sol_reentry.interpretation: 50% is an explicit operational resource-routing threshold proposed by the user, not an official standard, scientific pass line or deployment permission. Majority is a fixed observable priority heuristic, not a cognitive diagnosis.

primary_trigger.observable_table_failure_with_correct_pr: Among completed patch wrong-input outputs: frozen-reference proposal correct AND table incorrect or patch invalid; this is partial-answer/table discrepancy, not proven understood-but-formatting error.
